notes: Confirmed against the body. It resolves two provider paths from the global context, queries nested_attribute_provider_get_float with selector 0x1d for each, converts both returned floats to signed integers, stores the first in the output, then adds the second and stores the sum. The behavior index has no callers, so the name stays at the observed selector/value flow.

Confirmed against the full body. It combines a vector float with an input scalar, scales/divides and rounds it, converts and stores a signed 16-bit value at the nested record pointer+0x14, then, for the positive branch, calls sampled_flight_segment_interpolate and stores three float outputs at owner offsets +0x48, +0x4c, and +0x50. Indexed caller evaluate_catch_loco_working_ring_position invokes this helper in its flight-position/catch-ring flow, supporting the flight-segment label.

Confirmed against the body. It loads a selected 32-bit value from the global table and writes a boolean to the output. The value first passes the record-value predicate for the 0x20-range; otherwise values in 0x81-0x82 pass only when attribute-context selector 0x13 is not status 6. This supports the conservative name without asserting an original record type. The behavior index has no callers.

Confirmed against the full body. A null context returns 2; otherwise selector 0x2b is checked first and a positive value returns 1. If not positive, selector 0x32 is checked; a positive value returns 0, and otherwise the helper returns 2. The body obtains missing provider state through f_700183f6e4. The indexed caller stores this result in a temporary field before continuing its record processing, supporting the conservative classification name without asserting domain meanings for the return values.

Confirmed. When the input flag bit is clear, the function returns the float loaded from input+0x1c unchanged. When the bit is set, it reads the global mapping value (using 1.0 if the global object is absent), calls the established linear_remap_clamped helper with fixed range constants, and selects the result based on a predicate bit. The indexed callers use the returned scalar in vector calculations; the proposal describes the visible remap path without claiming its game-level domain.
